# ALIGNMENT -- wall autotile pieces.  Each 16x16 block is one variant drawn
# in all four quarters (TL quarter = wall_tile[WC_TL*WALL_VARIANTS + WV_x]...):
#   FILL  = solid interior     HEDGE = 1-cell-thick horizontal slab
#   VEDGE = vertical pillar     OUTER = lone block (convex corners)
#   INNER = 4 concave notches   FILL2 = interior with lit panels
# Purple hull (PAL_WALL): 1 = dark plating, 2 = neon edge, 3 = white glint.
# Edges: outer neon line (2), hot core (3), dim glow (1), black gap.
# FILL2 detail is self-contained per quarter.
